title: Chapter 1273 - 25: Testing Me?
content:
Chapter 1273 - 25: Testing Me?

Chapter 1273: Chapter 25: Testing Me?

For example, this magical trial space.

"Is the Master of Wu Shan held back by the Demon God?"

Lin Yuan asked the question that puzzled his heart.

Compared to nurturing a new Eternal Lord to sweep away the demon calamity, it would certainly be simpler and easier for a Thirteenth Stage Time Being to take action directly.

The Eternal Lord is not so easily cultivated; it can even be said that the Eternal Lord cannot be cultivated. Among the six Ancestors of the first Fang Yuan World, all five Ancestors after Da Fu Ancestor had not received special training from their predecessors before stepping into the Thirteenth Stage.

The Master of Wu Shan wants to cultivate a new Eternal Lord through the trial space, but the hope is very slim.

Therefore, Lin Yuan speculated that the Master of Wu Shan could not be free, and the last possible thing to hold him back could only be the ’Demon God’.

"Demon God?"

The golden figure shook his head, "Though powerful, the Demon God cannot hold back the great Master of Wu Shan."

"Not the Demon God?"

Lin Yuan became even more surprised, "Then who?"

"I do not know either."

The golden figure replied, "The Demon God is not the source of the demon calamity."

...

"Alright, I’ve said all I can say. This trial space was crafted with painstaking care by the Master of Wu Shan, and the ultimate inheritance contained within elaborates on the essence of the Rune Dao."

The golden figure looked at Lin Yuan and said, "With your understanding of space-time mastery, you still have a faint hope of passing. Even if you don’t pass, you can gain part of the inheritance, which will greatly benefit you."

"Now tell me, do you want to enter the trial space?"

The golden figure asked.

"The trial space of the Eternal Lord..."

Lin Yuan pondered for a moment, then asked, "Is there any danger?"

If there was danger, Lin Yuan planned to come back after reaching the peak of his cultivation.

After all, the trial space was here, and it wasn’t going anywhere. Lin Yuan could attempt it anytime.

"Danger?"

The golden figure sighed, "After witnessing the demon calamity massacre countless cultivators, the Master of Wu Shan would not set up dangers within the trial space."

"If you find the trial insurmountable, I will bring you out, without any danger."

The golden figure said with emotion, "If not for the high threshold of the Master of Wu Shan’s inheritance which could cause irreparable impact if unqualified cultivators forced comprehension, there might not even be a trial."

For beings like the Master of Wu Shan, spreading his inheritance without any trials would be filled with ill intent.

Setting up a trial is an act of mercy.

It prevents cultivators unsuitable for the inheritance from suffering irreparable losses.

"Then I am willing." Lin Yuan nodded immediately.

The Master of Wu Shan is a Thirteenth Stage Time Being, so how could Lin Yuan not desire his inheritance?

Moreover, with no danger? Isn’t that like being given for free? How could Lin Yuan refuse?

"Alright."

The golden figure looked at Lin Yuan and said, "Do not resist next."

"Okay."

Lin Yuan nodded.

Buzz— Runes echoed around, a space-time fluctuation engulfed Lin Yuan, instantly pulling him into a mysterious space.

"Where is this place?"

Lin Yuan looked around.

This is a vast world, Lin Yuan’s eyes caught those three giant ’paintings’ hanging at the center.

These three giant paintings consisted of a youth in golden armor, exuding a terrifying aura that transmitted even across the enormous canvas.

Next was a charming lady wearing nearly transparent gauze, her lips slightly upturned, invisible spiritual power, no ordinary strong practitioner in the Third Realm dared gaze long, risking ensnarement.

The last ’giant painting’ depicted a man in white; compared to the previous paintings, he exuded no aura, yet Lin Yuan felt the greatest threat from him.

"The powerful figures in these three ’paintings’ are each no less than the ’Abyss Dragon.’"

Lin Yuan’s expression grew a bit more solemn, he thought silently.

Especially the man in white in the last giant painting, who seemed to surpass even the Abyss Dragon.

"These three ’giant paintings’ were drawn by the great Master of Wu Shan."

At that moment, the golden figure appeared beside Lin Yuan, also looking into the distance at the three ’giant paintings.’

"The paintings of the Master of Wu Shan are all real, and the powerful figures in these three giant paintings are real too, capable of stepping out of the canvases."

The golden figure stated, "Each figure excelled in different aspects, drawn specifically by the Master of Wu Shan for future challengers."

"As long as you can pass the obstruction of the three giant paintings to enter there..."

The golden figure pointed towards the central area of the world.

There, a small door stood faintly.

"You will have passed the trial."

"It is about overcoming obstacles, not defeating them."

The golden figure said.

Then glanced at Lin Yuan, "With your strength, it’s difficult to directly bypass the obstruction from the powerful figures in the three giant paintings."

"My advice is to focus on enhancing your mastery of the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule; once you completely transcend the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule, you’ll pass the trial with ease."

The golden figure’s tone was calm.

By completely transcending the Space-Time Rule, one’s self becomes space-time; a single thought can appear outside the small door at the world’s center, making it impossible for the powerful figures in the giant paintings to obstruct you, let alone touch you.

This is the reason the golden figure believed Lin Yuan had a slight hope of passing the trial.

This so-called slight hope depended on Lin Yuan’s ability to completely transcend the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule. If he could transcend it, he could pass the trial.

If he couldn’t transcend it, he wouldn’t pass.

Though Lin Yuan’s understanding of the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule was close to transcendence, it was not yet the same as complete transcendence.

Completely transcending the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule seemed a dim hope.

But at least it was far higher than those whose understanding of space-time still hovered at the Ninth Realm in the Third Realm cultivator community.

"Completely transcend the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule?"

Lin Yuan slightly furrowed his brows, even the Chaos Void’s strongest state, His Majesty Xuanhuang, had only half a foot beyond the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule.

As for complete transcendence? Lin Yuan had confidence but didn’t know how long it would take, five thousand years? Ten thousand years?

Observing the operation of the Origin Source of the first Fang Yuan World had allowed Lin Yuan to make rapid progress in understanding the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule, but complete transcendence remained arduous.

"Take it slowly, you have all the time in the world—billions, trillions of years, the trial has no limits."

The golden figure stated.

Normally, to break through the obstruction of the powerful figures in the three giant paintings, one would need to surpass the strength of an ordinary Eternal Son.

This was the threshold for receiving the Master of Wu Shan’s inheritance—the idea that if you couldn’t surpass an ordinary Eternal Son, how could you possibly become the new Eternal Lord? Besides, only a sufficiently powerful being could cultivate the Master of Wu Shan’s heritage.

But with Lin Yuan’s insight into space-time, there’s no need to force through, as typically, few in the Third Realm reached the strength of an Eternal Son without external aids.

Never mind a frontal breakthrough of the obstruction of the powerful figures within the three giant paintings; the requirements for strength were even higher than those for an ordinary Eternal Son.

"Don’t underestimate them."

The golden figure looked at Lin Yuan and continued, "The powerful figures in these three giant paintings are seen by the Master of Wu Shan as the true limit of the Third Realm, much stronger than the typical Eternal Son, which is why the requirement is to break through the obstruction and enter the small door at the center of the world, rather than defeating them."

"Indeed, they are strong."

Lin Yuan nodded.

The first two of the three ’giant paintings’ possess the might of the ’Abyss Dragon,’ with the last even faintly surpassing ’Abyss Dragon.’ In theory, such powerful figures should not exist.

Since the opening of the first Fang Yuan World, only one Abyss Dragon has ever been born, blessed with countless opportunities and causes to achieve such strength.

The Eternal Sons of this Fang Yuan World only approach the strength of the Abyss Dragon; perhaps the Source Demons could rival or even exceed the Abyss Dragon, but they could not enter this trial space.
